references.text: Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Judah
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is the prince of the sons of Judah and leads the eastern camp
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, leads the army of the tribe of Judah during the wilderness journey
Amminadab is mentioned as the father of Nahshon in Aaron's genealogy
Amminadab and Nahshon are mentioned in Perez's lineage leading to David
Nahshon is mentioned as the son of Amminadab and prince of the sons of Judah in the genealogical record
Nahshon is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the son of Amminadab
